maisonPage.subtitle: Golden Grape was born from a simple dream: to share, in Luxembourg, the soul of a Portugal we love, choose and tell with care.
maisonPage.founderP1: Born in northern Portugal, Ivo grew up between his grandfather's vines and his mother's kitchen. He spent fifteen years in hospitality across Porto, Lisbon, then Luxembourg.
maisonPage.founderP2: In 2019, he founded Golden Grape — a house that celebrates artisans he knows by first name, the wines he loves, and the gestures he refuses to see fade.
maisonPage.founderQuote: My cellar is a map of Portugal — every bottle is a village, every village a family.

douro.name: Douro
douro.desc: Terraced vines, burning schists, powerful and mineral wines — the cradle of Port.

alentejo.name: Alentejo
alentejo.desc: Golden plains, olive trees, cork oaks. Generous reds, olive oil, bread and friendship.

minho.name: Minho
minho.desc: The green of the north, its light Vinhos Verdes, its gardens and granite barns.

dao.name: Dão
dao.desc: High-altitude vines, Touriga Nacional, elegance and freshness.

acores.name: Azores
acores.desc: Volcanic islands, DOP cheeses, Atlantic winds and lush pastures.

algarve.name: Algarve
algarve.desc: Salt, fish, citrus. Southern light, the gold of sand and sea.

values.d: A wine only enters our house after a visit, a handshake, a shared story.
Service is an art. It begins with a glance and ends in a silence.
A good moment never ends — it is told, replayed, passed on.
